name: Oc len
summary: Ốc lèn is a Chứt snail dish from the forest and streams around the park. With cơm pồi and rượu đoác, it is one of the three foods tied to Chứt daily life and festivals.
origin: Chứt villages in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: These dishes belong to daily life, custom, and festivals, not only to a meal.
howToEat: Ask in the Chứt villages whether it is on the table.
seoTitle: Oc len — a Chut snail at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Ốc lèn is a Chứt snail dish from the forest and streams around Phong Nha, one of three foods with cơm pồi and rượu đoác.
